home.title: Rototo
home.description: Rototo is a 360° arcade duel for iOS — spin your shield to face the swarm, reflect what they throw, and chase the top of the leaderboard.

control.title: One-Touch Control
control.description: Rototo pivots to face your finger or mouse. One input, 360° of coverage — line up the shield and let them come.

swarms.title: Orbiting Swarms
swarms.description: Breakout turned inside out: enemies circle the arena in escalating waves, and every reflect counts.

leaderboard.title: Game Center Leaderboards
leaderboard.description: Climb the ranks with Game Center high scores, built straight into iOS.

neon.title: Deep-Space Neon
neon.description: Warp streaks, breathing stars, and handcrafted purple — the start screen is only the beginning.
